context: Banchi's phone app was only the test bed: the question is whether the designer, design reviewer and design skills we built make clearly better-looking work. Two passes so far. First pass (Oct 28): you said it was not blind and read as a web page, not a phone app; that led to c191 (no repo colours in a blind brief) and c192 (iPhone and Duo guidance). Redraw (Oct 28 evening), after both fixes: three directions; you picked C2 Shelf. Compare the two Shelf drawings below. Found Oct 29 16:50 CDT: the designer never used the design skills we forked. agents/designer.md names only design-explore and ios-apps; frontend-design (visual direction) is loaded only by builders, and impeccable (critique and polish) only by the design-review skill's second reviewer. The redraw's notes mention neither. So both passes tested the designer without the taste skills. My own read: the redraw is phone-shaped with real Duo proportions, but I can't judge taste for you.
